rationale: The answer captures the basic three-way structure. It says the prospectus and KID describe a holdings-disclosure policy. It mentions daily portfolio publication. It also correctly treats the periodic route as conditional on daily arbitrage information for APs and market makers, which matches the grader note that this is not permission to withhold all daily information. However, it omits several substantive CBI Q&A 1012 conditions: (1) the arbitrage information must be available on a nondiscriminatory basis; (2) the prospectus must disclose that information; (3) there must be procedures for impaired arbitrage and for investor information requests; (4) quarter-end holdings must be published within 30 business days. On the transparency-policy disclosures, it omits marketing materials and stating where portfolio and iNAV information is available. It also omits that, under the daily route, the prospectus states what information is supplied and, if an iNAV is calculated, explains its calculation and frequency. It describes daily holdings generically as 'standard' practice rather than a permitted option provided on a nondiscriminatory basis. It does not confirm the 2026 regulations or the Q&A and hedges on the exact conditions. There is no material contradictory error, but the omissions are substantive.
